action: Keep full stories and video on owned pages, and give search only headlines and summaries marked up for citation in AI Overviews.
rationale: AI Overviews answer many news queries without a click. Being the cited source keeps referral traffic while full value stays on ETtoday pages.
revisit_trigger: Search share of ETtoday traffic falls 3 pp or more in a quarter

action: Shift short-video output from Facebook Reels to the ETtoday app and YouTube, keeping Facebook for headline links only.
rationale: Facebook referrals have fallen since the 2025 feed-ranking change, and Reels payouts do not cover production costs.
revisit_trigger: Meta restores news-link weight in feed ranking

action: Offer LINE TODAY exclusive explainer videos in exchange for a higher revenue share and audience data.
rationale: LINE TODAY reaches the widest news audience and the 2025 licensing deal performed well; exclusives strengthen the next negotiation.
revisit_trigger: LINE TODAY changes partner revenue share again

action: Sell YouTube channel video together with on-site pre-roll as one package for advertisers.
rationale: Video ad budgets are moving to YouTube; packaging both keeps the buyer relationship with ETtoday ad sales.
revisit_trigger: A close rival matches the package within its median lag

action: Publish exclusives in the app and newsletter 30 minutes before they are opened to search indexing.
rationale: A short head start moves loyal readers to owned channels without giving up search reach on the story.
revisit_trigger: Owned ratio (N4) stops rising for two quarters

action: Support bargaining-bill provisions that require platforms to give publishers notice of feed-ranking changes.
rationale: Unannounced ranking changes cut ETtoday traffic in 2025; notice rules reduce that risk for every platform.
revisit_trigger: The draft bargaining bill passes committee review or is withdrawn

action: Co-promote the ad-free membership through LINE official account rich menus.
rationale: LINE official accounts reach readers who already follow ETtoday, at low acquisition cost.
revisit_trigger: Membership sign-ups from LINE fall below 10% of the total

action: Pilot a dedicated Shorts news channel that links back to full reports in the app.
rationale: Shorts reach younger readers ETtoday does not reach on its own channels; links back test whether that reach converts.
revisit_trigger: YouTube changes how Shorts link to external sites

action: Prepare a licensing offer covering summary and AI-training use of ETtoday archives.
rationale: If bargaining rules pass, a ready offer lets ETtoday negotiate early rather than accept a standard rate.
revisit_trigger: Bargaining rules require platforms to pay for news use
